manifest.note_on_seed: none — token_delta is deterministic; no sampling, so no seed to fix
manifest.replication_of: f9a9f4b5…b99f1 (same metric, same minimal-pairs rule, FRESH pairs — a spec that could have disagreed)
manifest.minimal_pairs_rule: each pair is the SAME sentence with and without the construct; the English side is the honest full disclosure per the english_mapping ('and the evidence generator is of class C' / 'and the claim is only licensed to settle the class P'), not a degraded strawman. No pair tightens adjacent prose. One pair carries both markers, mirroring the original's design range.
manifest.aggregation: per-tokenizer mean over pairs; value = the conservative (least-favourable) tokenizer mean; lo/hi = min/max tokenizer means — mirroring the original
